name: Govinda R. Timilsina
notes: Main source: June-2025 CV (Selected Publications: journal articles and chapters; books/guidebooks skipped) plus his RePEc/IDEAS page (bylines for several items, 2024-26 papers, and recent unpublished World Bank PRWPs; PRWPs that later appeared as journal articles were dropped). The CV gives only '(with ...)' lists with no stated order: bylines taken from IDEAS where available, otherwise inferred (surname-alphabetical when the listed coauthors are alphabetical, else Timilsina first) - treat order as approximate. CV states years for few items; years inferred from volume/DOI where missing (e.g. WBRO urban road externalities listed as 2011). 'Regional Electricity Trade for Hydropower Development in South Asia' and several others list no coauthors in the CV (entered as sole author). The CV 'Energy Demand' handbook chapter and 'Targeted Technology Strategies' chapter have no year -> skipped. CV is 'selected', so list may be incomplete; Energy Policy 2026 'Household cooking in Nepal' added from IDEAS (not in CV).
